verdict.rationale: TruffleHog Enterprise has a web UI where findings flow, so the API-parity axis applies. The evidence pack documents no public API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The open-source CLI and outbound finding-routing webhooks are separate interfaces, not an API that mirrors the UI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
